name: Egyptian_WalkLikeOne
description: Description: This LoRA brings the rich and visually stunning world of Ancient Egypt to life. It covers a wide range of subjects, from majestic pharaohs and powerful gods to priestesses, mummies, temples, pyramids, and hieroglyphic-filled scenery. The model captures the iconic aesthetics of Egyptian mythology, blending gold, turquoise, lapis lazuli, ornate jewelry, and elaborate costumes into highly detailed images. With this LoRA you can create: Highly detailed character portraits Cinematic scenes set in ancient temples or deserts Epic depictions of Egyptian gods and goddesses Fantasy, horror, or adventure themed compositions Stylized or realistic interpretations depending on your settings The model supports a wide range of styles, from highly realistic to slightly stylized or fantasy-oriented looks, while keeping the recognizable Egyptian essence intact. 🔑 Key Trigger Words ThemeTrigger Words egypt, ancient egypt, egyptian, pharaoh, pyramid, temple, hieroglyphs, desert , nile, god/goddess, anubis, bastet, horus, seth, osiris, isis, apophis, thot, mummy, bandages, wrapped, glowing eyes, priestess, high priestess, royal headdress, ornate jewelry, golden jewelry, lapis lazuli, turquoise gems, ornate necklace, arm cuffs, headpiece, temple columns, hieroglyphic pillars, pyramids in background, ancient ruins, cinematic lighting, divine aura, mystical, desert sunset, dramatic lighting, khopesh, spear, bronze Also trained some places with names. Try around ;) 🖼 Prompt Examples Example 1 – God Anubis (Realistic Heroic Style): anubis, egyptian god, jackal head, muscular male, golden armor, ornate jewelry, egyptian temple background, hieroglyphic pillars, cinematic lighting, ultra detail, sharp focus Example 2 – Egyptian Priestess (High Fantasy Style): egyptian priestess, beautiful young woman, elaborate golden headdress, lapis lazuli jewelry, ornate necklace, arm cuffs, flowing white dress, pyramids in background, divine aura, soft sunlight, ultra detail, cinematic Example 3 – Mummy Horror Scene: egyptian mummy, ancient tomb, glowing eyes, wrapped in bandages, golden amulet, sandstorm, pyramids in distance, horror atmosphere, dramatic lighting, ultra detailed Example 4 – Gods Ensemble (Epic Group Scene): anubis, bastet, horus, isis, osiris, egyptian gods ensemble, standing in grand temple, ornate golden costumes, hieroglyphic walls, giant pillars, cinematic lighting, ultra detail 🔧 Recommended Settings LoRA Weight: 0.7 – 1.0 Works well with: SDXL 1.0 base models, Realistic/Photorealistic checkpoints, Fantasy & Stylized models.
